shortDescription: Create, update, or delete VAST VIPPool resources

options.name: bgp_config_id
options.description: BGP configuration ID for the VIP pool

options.name: client_monitoring_ips
options.description: External client monitoring IP ranges for VIP pool connectivity monitoring

options.name: cluster_id
options.description: Cluster Id

options.name: cnode_ids
options.description:
Dedicates a specific group of CNodes to the VIP pool. List the IDs of the CNodes. Separate IDs by commas. This is
a way to dedicate a specific set of CNodes to a specific set of client hosts or applications. Overridden if
cnode_names is passed.

options.name: cnode_names
options.description:
Dedicates a specific group of CNodes to the VIP pool. List the names of the CNodes. Separate names by commas.
This is a way to dedicate a specific set of CNodes to a specific set of client hosts or applications. Overrides
cnode_ids.

options.name: domain_name
options.description:
Domain name for the VAST DNS server. If a DNS configuration exists, the domain suffix defined in the DNS server
configuration is appended to this domain name to form a FQDN which the DNS server resolves to this VIP pool.

options.name: enable_l3
options.description:
Enables L3 networking, in which the cluster's CNodes act as Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) peers belonging to a
VAST Autonomous system (AS) which is connected to the client network's AS

options.name: enable_weighted_balancing
options.description: Enable weighted balancing

options.name: enabled
options.description: True for enable, False for disable

options.name: end_ip
options.description: Not currently in use. Use ip_ranges instead.

options.name: gw_ip
options.description: The IP address of a local gateway device if client traffic is routed through one.

options.name: gw_ipv6
options.description: The IP address of a local gateway device if client traffic is routed through one.

options.name: id
options.description: Resource ID for direct lookup. Mutually exclusive with name-based identification.

options.name: ip_ranges
options.description: An array of IP ranges included in the vippool.

options.name: name
options.description: The VIP pool name

options.name: peer_asn
options.description: Peer Asn

options.name: port_membership
options.description:
Allocates left, right or all CNode ports to the VIP pool. Allocating the left port and the right port in
different VIP pools enables the CNodes to be connected to multiple networks simultaneously. Default: all

options.name: role
options.description:
'PROTOCOLS' dedicates the VIP pool to client traffic from all of the supported access protocols (NFSv3, NFSv4.2,
SMBv2, S3, Database). At least one VIP pool must be created to enable client access. 'REPLICATION' dedicates the
VIP pool for connectivity with an async replication peer cluster. This is needed for async replication.
'BIG_CATALOG' dedicates the VIP pool to VAST Catalog query access from the client network.

options.name: start_ip
options.description: Not currently in use. Use ip_ranges instead.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource.

options.name: subnet_cidr
options.description: The subnet expressed as a CIDR index (number of bits in each IP that belong to the subnet)

options.name: subnet_cidr_ipv6
options.description: The subnet expressed as a CIDR index (number of bits in each IP that belong to the subnet)

options.name: tenant_id
options.description: Tenant ID

options.name: vast_asn
options.description: Vast Asn

options.name: vlan
options.description:
To tag the VIP pool with a specific VLAN on the data network, specify the VLAN (0-4096). The VIP pool will be
exposed only to the specified VLAN on the client network.

options.name: vms
options.description: VAST VMS connection parameters.

options.name: vms_preferred
options.description: If true, CNodes participating in the vip pool to be preferred in VMS host election.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for async operations to complete.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for async operations.
